newsitem.title: USA: Campbell files shelf for $1 bln in debt.
newsitem.headline: Campbell files shelf for $1 bln in debt.

text.p: Campbell Soup Co filed Friday a shelf registration with the Securities and Exchange Commission for up to $1 billion in debt securities.

The food product company said net proceeds from the sale will be used to repay short-term debt, including short-term debt borrowed to fund purchases of common stock under the stock repurchase program.
Net proceeds will also be used to reduce or retire from time to time other indebtedness, and for other general corporate purposes including use of funds for possible acquisitions, the filing said.
No underwriters were named in the filing.
